items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And then the trombone players was Wilbur, D. Parris. ... Was Oliver Everwith, Orr was with us one time. Eddie Orr, he was among the first.

ctx.x: He plays violins, still plays violins.
Yes, yes, yes. Play an instrument. Then Wilbur Parrish that she named.
